notes: Multi-sensor reconciliation (FM-023). gate_confidence is deliberately matched to the tracker's association gate in backend/tracking/association/gnn.py — see backend/fusion/README.md for why they must not drift apart. max_fusable_uncertainty_m is the bound that stops a sensor reporting an absurd covariance from absorbing a contact it cannot locate; it constrains the measurement rather than the separation, because a flat distance ceiling tight enough to catch bad covariances also splits the legitimate 200-300m spread of this site's own radars.
